description: Move up to 100 conversations to Spam (spam true) or back to the inbox (spam false). Returns updatedIds, unchangedIds and notFoundIds; retrying is safe.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

conversationIds.description: Conversation IDs to move, from 1 to 100. Duplicates are ignored.

spam.description: True moves them to Spam; false back.

name: bulk_update_conversation_spam

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `bulk_update_conversation_spam` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

notFound.description: IDs that do not exist in the selected company.

notFoundIds.description: IDs that do not exist in the selected company.

spam.description: True when the conversations were moved to Spam.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
